papers.title: Functional error modeling for uncertainty quantification in hydrogeology
papers.abstract: Abstract Approximate models (proxies) can be employed to reduce the computational costs of estimating uncertainty. The price to pay is that the approximations introduced by the proxy model can lead to a biased estimation. To avoid this problem and ensure a reliable uncertainty quantification, we propose to combine functional data analysis and machine learning to build error models that allow us to obtain an accurate prediction of the exact response without solving the exact model for all realizations. We build the relationship between proxy and exact model on a learning set of geostatistical realizations for which both exact and approximate solvers are run. Functional principal components analysis (FPCA) is used to investigate the variability in the two sets of curves and reduce the dimensionality of the problem while maximizing the retained information. Once obtained, the error model can be used to predict the exact response of any realization on the basis of the sole proxy response. This methodology is purpose‐oriented as the error model is constructed directly for the quantity of interest, rather than for the state of the system. Also, the dimensionality reduction performed by FPCA allows a diagnostic of the quality of the error model to assess the informativeness of the learning set and the fidelity of the proxy to the exact model. The possibility of obtaining a prediction of the exact response for any newly generated realization suggests that the methodology can be effectively used beyond the context of uncertainty quantification, in particular for Bayesian inference and optimization.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合函数主成分分析和机器学习的代理模型误差校正方法，可用于不确定性量化，其思路可迁移至生物力学代理模型的误差建模。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on hydrogeology and does not address implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or structural optimization constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 代理模型引入偏差，需校正以可靠量化不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 用函数主成分分析和机器学习构建代理与精确模型间的误差模型。
summary_zh.result: 误差模型可准确预测精确响应，适用于不确定性量化、贝叶斯推断和优化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过水文地质模拟案例验证误差模型预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: Surrogate models introduce bias that must be corrected for reliable uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Functional principal component analysis and machine learning are combined to build an error model mapping proxy responses to exact responses.
summary_en.result: The error model accurately predicts exact responses, enabling unbiased uncertainty quantification and applicability to Bayesian inference and optimization.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on hydrogeological simulation cases comparing predicted exact responses with true exact solver outputs.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注术前股骨颈几何预测股骨柄前倾角，未涉及应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on surgical planning of stem anteversion.

summary_zh.motivation: 术前预测股骨柄前倾角以优化假体定位。
summary_zh.method: 基于术前股骨颈几何测量与术后CT对比的回顾性研究。
summary_zh.result: 股骨颈几何参数可预测前倾角，但个体差异大。
summary_zh.validation: 临床术后CT验证预测准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To determine if preoperative femoral neck geometry can predict femoral stem anteversion for improved implant positioning.
summary_en.method: A retrospective study correlating preoperative radiographic measurements of femoral neck geometry with postoperative CT-derived stem anteversion.
summary_en.result: Femoral neck geometry shows moderate predictive value for stem anteversion, but substantial interpatient variability remains.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation using postoperative CT scans from a patient cohort.

papers.title: The impact of the leg-lengthening total hip arthroplasty on the coronal alignment of the spine
papers.abstract: Coronal imbalance of pelvis is recognized to develop a degenerative lumbar scoliosis. We hypothesized that an abrupt change of pelvic obliquity may show a reproducible trend of coronal compensation in the lumbosacral spine. The aim of the study was to classify the change of coronal alignment of spine after THA.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术后脊柱冠状位对齐的变化，未涉及股骨假体应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on spinal coronal alignment after THA, not on femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究全髋关节置换术后下肢延长对脊柱冠状位对齐的影响。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析THA患者术前术后脊柱全长X线片，测量冠状位参数。
summary_zh.result: 发现THA术后骨盆倾斜变化与腰椎代偿性弯曲有可重复趋势。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of leg lengthening during total hip arthroplasty on coronal spinal alignment.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of pre- and postoperative full-length spine radiographs in THA patients, measuring coronal parameters.
summary_en.result: A reproducible trend of coronal compensation in the lumbosacral spine was observed following changes in pelvic obliquity after THA.
